content: Hana wana Awanun
Yaka Hana i awanun i ba:

content.text: “Ateu i yaliyaya Yehoba elam, no gasisi i noem owa eliyam.
Ya ba hanaha o topihigelgel elal, ya yaliyaya kaiwena u pwamwalau.
Nige etega i bwabwalena i oola owa Yehoba, nige yabowaine etega al i gagan, ge nige Pat abalou etega i oola wama Yabowaine owa.
O topihigelgel elal na ba, ‘Wami ba hanahanaha ku paveyaho! Besemiu ba haha!
Kaiwena Yehoba iya Yabowaine toto bugul gegewena i atena, ge iya wala ginol gegewena i hihile.’
Tolohaveyan gasigasisel wali egipoyo i gabogabomwan, yaa bolo hi pweyata i pagasisi-agil.
Bolo valila tineliya i kiya, tuwalali hi loya wali aanan kaiwena, yaa bolo valila hi galebu, iyaka nige al hi gagalebu.
Yova toto valila i kobwas, sauga ya wawayau ali gewi seben i abil, yaa yova toto valila natunau bolau hi gewi, iyaka hi yaomal haba nige ana tomatahikan.
Yehoba iya yawal ana toahe, iya al yawal ana topem. Enuna i teli lowagil salaiya ge enuna i teli heyagil.
Yehoba gamagalau enuna i pagulagula-agil, ge enuna i pagogomwau-agil, enuna i pahanalowagil, ge enuna i teli heyagil abamina bwabwatana elana.
Togulagula i palutil papakova gamwanaa, ge i latahiniliem wali miloloyowana.
Ali hehegan i abubun hi ola kin natunau, ge i telel hi minaa abamisiyo wawasana elana.
He i ola, kaiwena panayawi labena gegewena Yehoba wana bugul. Bugul gegewel i telel abaliyaa ge ali logugui i ginol.
Wana gamagalau bwabwalel i matahikagil, yaa nak ana toginol nihi yaomal nihi na nihi minaa gogouwa.
Nige bosowaina gamagal totona wana gasisi elana ge ni tagalaka.
Bolo hi pihigelgel Yehoba elana ni apapanak-agil hoti.
He ali lahi ni baunan wana baaba ni ola gulumwawa i loem labulabumwa, Yehoba panayawi labena esopali ni payatalal.
Gasisi ni pek wana kin elana, iya wana hilihili gamagalina wana gasisi ni pwabwata.”

content: Yaka Elekana alona ge lagona Hana hi sikal hi na wali panuwaa Lama, yaa geman Samuwela hi eguluwana to i totuwalali Yehoba kaiwena Ilai wana logugui gabulanaa.
Ilai Natunau Bolau Sisigal
Ilai natunau bolau labui Hopni ge Pinehas wali ginol nige i wawaisi, nige Yehoba hi aawatauwan.
He powon bwasumona bunumwina toto topowon kaiweliya ana logugui nige hi totoulil.

Sauga ebo gamagal etega ni na bwasumu ni powonan Yehoba elana, ge bunumwina ni ligaliga aanan kaiwena, Hopni ge Pinehas nige nihi mamatamatan ali bunum ni gabom elal. Yaa wali totuwalali etega nihi patuna pok bwabwatana matana eton ni ahe ge ni nok.

Inoke ni paulu lowan ulun gamwanaa, yaka bunum toto ni howa pwawa ni ahe topowon labui o kaiweliya. He Isileli gegewel bolo hi na panuwa Sailo ge bwasumu nihi powonan Yehoba elana, ali hehegan hi giginol i olaola ya to.
Ge i ola al, sauga enuna nige ga posa nihi toton abapowon elana,
yaka topowon wali totuwalali ni na ni baek tau toto i popowon elana ni ba, “Topowon ana bunum enuna nu pem ni ekeke. Iya nige nuwana i oola toto liligana nu pek, nuwana kolena.”

Ge ebo tau ni ba, “Nigeya, binimala posa ga ta ton houwa Yehoba elana, yaka abwe hauna gabom toto nuwam, he nu ahe,” inoke anana totuwalali ni lahe ni ba, “Nigeya! Sauga ya nu pem! Ebo nigeya, nasi totou na ahe.”
He Ilai natunau bolau labui wali gegi i bwata hot Yehoba matanaa, kaiwena ana powon nige hi aawatauwan.
Yaa geman Samuwela topowon ali kaliko, kaliko waiwaisana hi ginoliya, alana ipod,
i gagaloi ge i totuwalali Yehoba kaiwena.

Baliman maisena ge maisena Hana Samuwela ana holahola yayapona ni ginol ana luvi elana. Inoke sauga alona ge lagona nihi na baliman maisena ge maisena ana powon nihi ginol Yehoba elana, yaka holahola o ni ahe ni na ni pek Samuwela elana.

He mulaa abwe Elekana ge lagona nihi sikal wali panuwaa, Ilai ni ba mulolu-agil ni ba, “Ya awanun Yehoba ni mulolu-agimiu natumiyau enuna al Hana ni abil, inoke wawaya toto i guyauan Yehoba elana abana nihi milahe.”
Inoke Yehoba Hana i muloluan, yaka abwe wawayau bolau eton ge yowau labui i abil. Yaa geman Samuwela i bwataa Yehoba wana limiya.

He Ilai iyaka i liki hot, natunau bolau labui wali ginol nanakina gegewena Isileli gegewel elal wasana i hago. I hago al te avaliyau yowau bolo hi tutuwalaliya Petupatupa Limena ana abatuktuk elana hi gaganawal.
Yaka i baek elal i ba, “Hauna kaiwena ginol ya ku awaawaginol? Gamagalau no wasa hi pem wami ginol nanakina kaiweliya.
He nuku bakuhu, natuwau. Wasa toto ya hago hi papalelu Yehoba wana gamagalau gamwaliyaa nige i wawaisi.

Binimala gamagal gegi ni ginol wana pan gamagal elana, Yabowaine bosowaina ni label ge gegi o nihi pasapu. Yaa ebo gamagal ni gegi Yehoba elana, nige etega bosowaina gamagal o ni labe.” Yaa Ilai natunau bolau labui nige hi oolak tamaliya wana pahepahenapu elana, kaiwena Yehoba wana nuwatu i ola te ni tagapaaligal.
He geman Samuwela i bwabwata nawa ge i ola al Yehoba ge gamagalau hi yaliyaya-an nabiyan.
Yehoba I Ba Ilai ana Tini Nige Al Nihi Totopowon
Lan etega palopita etega i na i baek Ilai elana i ba, “Yehoba i ba ola hiwe: Sauga boda Isileli hi minaa Itipita ana kin wana paloloyowan elana, inoke totou ya pamasalau tubum Eloni ge ana un elal.

Isileli ali un gegewel gamwaliyaa tubum Eloni ya hile ni tabwa no topowon, bwasumu ni powonan abapowona, bugul bwalena waiwaisana ni ton ana abatontona, ge topowon bwabwatana ana kaliko alana ipod ni galoi ni talmilil maniniwa. I ola al ya talam Isileli wali powon bwasumona gabomwina enuna tubum Eloni ana un nihi an.

Ga i ola o powon ge o mulolu nige ku aawatauwan? Natumwau ali awatauwan i bwata, yaa nau o awatauwan nige i bwabwata. No gamagalau Isileli wali powon bwasumona gabomwiliyau bolo waiwaisal ku mimi anani inoke eliyana ku lotabwa.

“Nau Yehoba Isileli wami Yabowaine, valila ya bateli am tini toto i noem tubumwau elal nuku topowon kaiweu sauga gegewena. He iyaka nige al ni oola to! Bolo hi awatauwagau, heliya te na awatauwagil, yaa bolo hi awatautau elau, na towaagil.
Sauga i nenem am tini bolauiliyau na pwamowasel. Nige tubutubumwau bolau etega wana liki hot ni pwapwawa.
Pulowan nihi gewi nihi masal am tini gamwanaa. No mulolu na guyauan boda Isileli elal, yaa komiu nige etega wana liki hot ni pwapwawa.
Ebo tubutubunim etega nige na aahek yoho abanaa ni topowon, he iya ni nuwanuwanak ge ni kahikahin matanununa ni laulau. Tubutubumwau gegewel wali sauga gasisi gamwanaa te nihi aliga.
Natumwau bolau labui Hopni ge Pinehas nihi aliga lan maisena elana, inoke toto ya ni ola wam etotohi ge nu atena bugul gegewena bolo ya baunan eliyam abwe nihi tunahot.

“He topowon etega na pamilil toto bosowaina ana mel na teli ge ni ginol ni ola hauna ya nuwatuan atewa. Na ba iya ana tini ni tutubwe ya, ge nihi topowon no hilihili gamagaliliyau kin ona elal sauga gegewena.

Inoke tubutubumwau bolo nige nihi aaliga, gegewel nihi na nihi loepwakoku matanaa nihi awanun mani kekeisi ge aanan mumwina kaiwena. Nihi ba, ‘U hilema topowon naha label, yaka aama ni gan naha aanan.’”

footnotes.text: Ebo Isileli heliheliyam powonina bwasumona nihi powonan, logugui i ba bunumwina enuna nihi pek topowon elal ali gabom. Libai 7:31-36 nu kite. I ola al Heliheliyam Powonina nu kite Baaba Ona ali Sapu ana Abaloya elana lamwa 237 Abatelipuna, Totagil, Yosuwa, Ludi, Daniyela ge Yona ali buki elana.
Mosese wana Logugui i ba sauga heliheliyam powonina bwasumona nihi lol, houwan hot posa nihi ton Yehoba elana (Libai 3:14-16).

Ipod iya holahola etega. He topowon bwabwatana ana ipod hihiu ali kala tomaha hi ginoliya (Totagil 28:6-11 nu kite), yaa topowon gegewel al ali ipod kaliko waiwaisana awawana hi ginoliya, tabam i wawakeki ya.
